row.team_price_text: Get a quote (activity-based, ingest or workload pricing, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Splunk's docs say "With system for cross-domain identity management (SCIM), you can configure the Splunk platform to sync user deletions from the IdP"; Splunk Cloud Platform itself is sold only by quote ("Get a quote").
row.notes: Status kept gated: Splunk Cloud Platform has no public price (activity-based, ingest or workload pricing via quote, unlimited users), so SCIM needs a sales contract. The June 'Enterprise tier' and '9.1+' qualifiers have no first-party source and were dropped: Splunk Cloud has no tier ladder, and SAML/SCIM are self-service settings on the platform. SCIM is documented only to delete SAML users removed from the IdP (up to one hour, only users added after SCIM is on); SAML users are created on login with group-to-role mapping. Okta's OIN app (updated Apr 2026) now advertises create/update/deactivate for administrative accounts, which Splunk's own docs do not describe. The ACS REST API manages local users and roles but cannot delete SAML users.

plans.name: Splunk Cloud Platform
plans.price_text: Get a quote: activity-based, ingest, or workload pricing for unlimited users
plans.notes: Single quote-priced offering; no public tiers.

auth.token_source: IdP admin chooses Splunk username/password, a Bearer token, or OAuth 2.0 (Issuer URL and Client ID entered under Settings > Authentication Methods > SAML Configuration > Automated User Management)

operations.notes: Splunk documents SCIM only for syncing user deletions; create/update via SCIM are not described.

roles.notes: Roles come from SAML group-to-role mapping at login, not SCIM.

limitations.text: SCIM only syncs deletions; by default Splunk does not keep users in sync with the IdP.
Deletes can take up to one hour and only apply to users added to the IdP after SCIM was turned on.
Requires SAML SSO and an IdP SAML app that supports SCIM; documented only on the Okta SSO page.

auth.notes: Splunk authentication token; caller's role needs ACS capabilities (sc_admin has all).

limitations.text: Users and roles are per search head; ACS does not replicate them across the search tier.
List calls return 30 items by default, up to 100 per page.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password, Schema Discovery and Entitlement Management.

entra.notes: Microsoft's tutorial covers SSO only; no provisioning tutorial found.

onelogin.notes: Splunk documents OneLogin SAML SSO; OneLogin's own catalogue not checked.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's Splunk article covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.notes: SAML users get access through IdP group-to-role mapping at login.

conflicts.text: Okta's OIN page says the Splunk Cloud app provisions, updates and deprovisions administrative accounts; Splunk's own docs describe SCIM only as syncing user deletions.

open_questions: Whether Splunk's SCIM endpoint accepts create/update (the Okta OIN app claims it does) is not documented by Splunk.
SCIM attributes, filtering, pagination and rate limits are undocumented.
Whether deleting a user frees licence capacity is moot (users are unlimited) but data/knowledge-object handling on delete is undocumented.
No audit-log REST API or user-event webhooks were documented in the pages checked (audit data lives in the _audit index).
